To a solution of 2,4-dichloro-5-ethylpyrimidine (5.00 g, 28.20 mmol) in DMF (50 mL) were added

chloride (0.99 g, 1.41 mmol). After the addition, the mixture was degassed and purged with N2 for 3
mins and then stirred at 85 ℃ for 4 hrs. After cooling to 20 ℃, The reaction solution was poured into
water (50 mL) and extracted with EtOAc (50 mL × 3). The combined organic layers were washed
with brine (50 mL × 2), dried over Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated under reduced pressure to give
a residue, which was purified by flash silica gel chromatography (SiO2, ethyl acetate: petroleum ether
= 0% - 10%) to afford the title compound (5.00 g, 83% yield) as colorless oil. LCMS(ESI): m/z 213.2
